title: Attention Is All You Need
original_summary: Introduces the attention-based Transformer architecture as an alternative to recurrent sequence models.
implementation_question: Implement attention, position encodings, FFN and causal mask; compare against a small recurrent baseline.

title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
original_summary: Studies parameter/token allocations under fixed training compute and highlights undertraining of large models.
implementation_question: Fit loss curves for local token and parameter budgets instead of assuming a universal ratio.

title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
original_summary: Investigates sparsely activated expert layers and routing/training stability.
implementation_question: Compare sparse active FLOPs and communication against equally tuned dense baselines.

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
original_summary: Uses IO-aware tiling to reduce memory traffic for exact attention.
implementation_question: Profile full-model prefill/decode by context length on local hardware.

title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
original_summary: Improves attention work partitioning and GPU occupancy relative to earlier kernels.
implementation_question: Measure end-to-end gain, not just a kernel microbenchmark.

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
original_summary: Proposes selective state-space sequence modeling with a hardware-aware algorithm.
implementation_question: Test retrieval/exact copying over long contexts at matched quality and compute.

title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
original_summary: Explores mathematical connections between attention and state-space models and an efficient Mamba-2 design.
implementation_question: Evaluate quality vs latency vs effective context on target hardware.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
original_summary: Describes a large MoE model with attention and training-system co-design; reported measurements are author claims.
implementation_question: Ablate router, attention/KV cost and token prediction objective at small scale.

title: LongRoPE: Extending LLM Context Window Beyond 2 Million Tokens
original_summary: Studies positional interpolation for length extension; context support must be distinguished from effective recall.
implementation_question: Evaluate exact fact retrieval, reasoning and latency at extended positions.

title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
original_summary: Introduces long-term neural memory alongside attention in hybrid memory architectures.
implementation_question: Compare neural learned state against timestamped external retrieval memory.

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
original_summary: Derives a direct pairwise preference objective as an alternative to conventional reward-model plus RL pipelines.
implementation_question: Compare SFT/DPO on preference accuracy, calibration and hidden tasks.

title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking
original_summary: Trains models to produce useful intermediate rationales for future-token predictions.
implementation_question: Test reasoning improvement on unseen questions and cost of internal generation.

title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
original_summary: Reports improved reasoning from reinforcement learning and staged training; limitations include reward and verification design.
implementation_question: Replicate a narrow verifiable-reward condition rather than the full frontier-scale recipe.

title: s1: Simple test-time scaling
original_summary: Explores high-quality selected traces and decoder-side budget forcing at inference.
implementation_question: Plot quality vs generated tokens for fixed/adaptive stopping.

title: Scaling Up RL: Unlocking Diverse Reasoning in LLMs via Prolonged Training
original_summary: Studies prolonged RL and stability adjustments across reasoning domains.
implementation_question: Probe whether training gain transfers across independently generated problem families.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
original_summary: Combines parametric models with explicit non-parametric retrieval for factual tasks.
implementation_question: Measure temporal fact corrections, retrieval error and quality per token.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
original_summary: Interleaves model reasoning with actions that gather external observations.
implementation_question: Inject tool errors and evaluate reliable recovery vs direct answers.

title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
original_summary: Presents varied interactive environments for assessing multi-turn tool and agent behavior.
implementation_question: Create controlled unseen task and tool shifts for transfer tests.

title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
original_summary: DreamerV3 uses learned dynamics and imagined trajectories across diverse control tasks.
implementation_question: Test learned dynamics and uncertainty-aware planning on new mechanics.

title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
original_summary: Studies large-scale self-supervised visual pretraining with curated data.
implementation_question: Benchmark visual feature robustness under distribution shift.

title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
original_summary: Investigates open vision-language-action policies trained on robot demonstrations.
implementation_question: Replicate narrow grounding/transfer tasks only with licensed data.

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
original_summary: Reports self-supervised video predictive learning and action-conditioned planning extensions.
implementation_question: Compare visual dynamics inference against simple symbolic state observations.

title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
original_summary: Provides multi-scenario/multi-metric language model evaluation principles.
implementation_question: Include robustness, calibration, bias, efficiency and accuracy as independent axes.

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
original_summary: Introduces executable real-repository issue resolution tasks.
implementation_question: Pin repository environments and report execution-valid completions.

title: LiveCodeBench: Holistic and Contamination Free Evaluation of Large Language Models for Code
original_summary: Advocates time-stamped, multi-scenario coding evaluation with contamination controls.
implementation_question: Use time held-out tasks and detect leaked solutions.

title: Demystifying Synthetic Data in LLM Pre-training: A Systematic Study of Scaling Laws, Benefits, and Pitfalls
original_summary: Reports mixture-dependent tradeoffs of natural and synthetic pretraining data.
implementation_question: Ablate synthetic proportion with training/validation parity.

title: Scaling Laws for Mixture Pretraining Under Data Constraints
original_summary: Studies repetition-aware data mixing when target-domain data is scarce.
implementation_question: Ablate repeat count vs generalization at fixed compute.

title: Diffusion Language Models: An Experimental Analysis
original_summary: Compares discrete diffusion language model performance against compute and decoding configurations.
implementation_question: Measure quality vs denoising steps and autoregressive baseline, including wall time.

title: Large Language Continuous Diffusion Models
original_summary: Introduces author-reported continuous latent diffusion language modeling and experimental generation tradeoffs.
implementation_question: Reproduce small-model comparisons and verify low-step stability without leaderboard cherry-picking.

title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
original_summary: Studies learning interactive action-controllable generative environments from videos.
implementation_question: Evaluate action-conditioned world reconstruction and unseen mechanics.

title: PRISM: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
original_summary: Explores search and self-verification for discrete diffusion language models; reported efficiency may depend on inference budget and evaluation.
implementation_question: Compare diffusion NFE, latency and accuracy with independent verifiers.
